fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. 1. Other materials Such as published papers, award certificates, work or internship certificates, can also be submitted in the form of attachments. * 2. Non-criminal Record Report Applicants are required to submit a valid certificate of Non-Criminal Record issued by the local public security authority, usually issued within 6 months prior to the submission date of the application. 3. Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) * 4. Copy of Passport All applicants are required to upload color-scanned clear and complete passport information page. Applicants already in China must submit color scanned visa within the validity period and the latest entry stamp. * 5. Passport photo All applicants are requested to submit a color two-inch bareheaded registration photo in the system, with a white background and noborder, size 100-500KB, JPG format. * 6. Academic transcripts (written in Chinese or English) Transcripts in other languages(expect Chinese and English) must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translation. * 7. Scanned certificate of diploma or highest degree Applicants must submit either scanned certificate of diploma or highest degree. If the degree certificate is not acquired yet, the previously acquired academic certificate must be submitted. (Any other relevant documents are unacceptable) If the academic certificate is non-English or non-Chinese, the original must be attached with notarized Chinese or English translations. The highest level of education must be filled in the previously acquired degree. * 8. Applicants must submit Foreigner Physical Examination Form (photocopy) written in English. Applicants who will study in China for more than 3 months or applicants age 60 and above must submit Foreigner Physical Examination Form (photocopy) written in English or Chinese. The physical examinations must cover all of the items listed in the form. Incomplete forms or forms without the signature of the attending physician, or the official stamp of the hospital, or a sealed photograph of the applicant are considered as invalid. Please carefully plan your physical examination schedule as the result is valid for only 6 months. You can download a template or sample from here . * 9. Study Plan A study plan or research proposal (written in Chinese or English). No less than 500 words for Bachelor’s Program. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens and meet the criteria specified in the Notice by the Ministry of Education of Regulating Admission of International Students to China's Higher Education Institutions (Letter No.12 [2020] of the Ministry of Education), physically and mentally healthy, friendly to China and have no criminal record. 2. Applicants should possess at minimum a high school diploma or equivalent qualification. 3. Language proficiency requirements: Chinese-taught majors: Applicants must pass the HSK Level 4 examination (240 points or above) . Applicants with the highest level of education taught in Chinese are exempt from providing an HSK certificate, but must provide proof of the language of instruction. Applicants who haven’t reached the required Chinese language level can apply for Preparatory Programs (Chinese Language Program).
